rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for intentionally taking down a building or other structure.

example.english: We will demolish this old building tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋聽日會拆呢棟舊樓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 wui5 caak3 ni1 dung6 gau6 lau4

rows.note: Use this for defeating an opponent decisively, rather than for refuting an argument or consuming something.

example.english: We demolish our opponents in this match.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 coeng4 bo1 daa2 dai1 deoi3 sau2

rows.note: Use this when an argument, theory, or belief is thoroughly refuted or discredited.

example.english: The professor can demolish this argument with one sentence.
example.traditional: 教授一句就駁倒呢個論點。
example.jyutping: gaau3 sau6 jat1 geoi3 zau6 bok3 dou2 ni1 go3 leon6 dim2

rows.note: Use this for consuming all of something, especially food, rather than defeating a person or argument.

example.english: I demolish the whole plate of fried rice by myself.
example.traditional: 我一個人食晒成碟炒飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 sik6 saai3 sing4 dip6 caau2 faan6
